meaning_moves.label: Ordinary object becomes proof
meaning_moves.description: A familiar object stops being background and becomes evidence of the hidden story.
prompt_fragments: ordinary household object framed as decisive evidence
clear proof object in the foreground
anti_patterns: generic symbol montage without visible object

meaning_moves.label: Screen sees hidden layer
meaning_moves.friendly_label: The screen sees what people cannot
meaning_moves.description: A mediated viewpoint reveals a layer not visible to direct sight.
prompt_fragments: phone screen reveals colder hidden version of the room
anti_patterns: unexplained sci-fi glow without a readable reveal

meaning_moves.label: Public message becomes warning
meaning_moves.description: Cheerful or official messaging accidentally reveals the threat it denies.
prompt_fragments: cheerful poster claim contradicted by visual evidence
public warning copy over domestic proof

story_engines.label: Evidence escalates
story_engines.friendly_label: The proof gets harder to deny
story_engines.description: Each beat adds clearer proof until denial becomes impossible.
anti_patterns: six beats that repeat the same discovery

story_engines.label: Domestic breach
story_engines.description: A normal home setting becomes a threshold or infiltration zone.
prompt_fragments: ordinary domestic space becoming a threshold
home interior breached by hidden conflict
anti_patterns: generic haunted house without archive evidence

story_engines.label: False commercial
story_engines.description: Commercial language promises normalcy while the visuals reveal the opposite.
prompt_fragments: cheerful commercial layout corrupted by evidence
poster art claim that contradicts itself
anti_patterns: turning every beat into sales copy

story_engines.label: Ritual archive
story_engines.description: Repeated media details become a pattern that feels ceremonial or mythic.
prompt_fragments: repeated domestic signs forming a ritual archive
final image reframes the archive as witness
anti_patterns: abstract mythology with no concrete beat image

beat_functions.label: Hook image
beat_functions.friendly_label: The first image asks a question
beat_functions.description: A readable opening image contains one detail that will matter later.
prompt_fragments: clear hook image with one suspicious detail
anti_patterns: opening with exposition instead of image

beat_functions.label: First proof
beat_functions.description: The story crosses from hint to evidence.
prompt_fragments: first undeniable proof visible in the frame

beat_functions.label: Final image
beat_functions.friendly_label: The final image changes the earlier images
beat_functions.description: The closing frame reframes the whole sequence without overexplaining.
prompt_fragments: ambiguous final image that reinterprets earlier evidence
anti_patterns: ending with a paragraph of explanation
